description: Retrieval benchmark over the five papers. A chunk is RELEVANT to a question when it belongs to `document` and contains every string of at least one group in `evidence` (case- and whitespace-insensitive). Relevance is defined on the text, not on chunk ids, so the same questions score any chunking strategy. Questions name the paper or method they are about, as a user of a multi-document index would.
